entities.name: Miklós Barabás
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miklós Barabás was a Hungarian painter. He is mostly known for his portrait paintings, including a famous portrait of a young Franz Liszt, done in 1847 and an 1853 portrait of Emperor Franz Joseph I.
